[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
Managing a large farm can be a chore, especially when you need to reorganize your barns and coops. Tired of clicking "Change Home" on every single pig individually?

Mass Animal Mover adds a convenient, native-style menu that lets you transfer multiple animals between buildings instantly. Whether you are moving cows to a new Barn or sending chickens to Ginger Island, this mod makes it a one-click process.

[center][youtube]_-AyG4wKCa4[/youtube]﻿[/center]

[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Bulk Transfers:[/b] Select as many animals as you want and move them all at once.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Cross-Location Support:[/b] Fully supports moving animals between the main Farm, Ginger Island (IslandWest), and other remote locations.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Mod Support:[/b] Tested and working with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Grandpa's Farm, and other custom maps.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Smart Capacity:[/b] The UI clearly shows the capacity of your buildings and prevents you from overfilling them.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Teleportation:[/b] Animals are instantly transported to the interior of their new home (or the doorstep if outside), so you don't have to wait for them to walk there.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41425/41425-1768791070-1565193631.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][b]How to Use
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you are standing still and not in a cutscene.

[*]Press [b]Z[/b] (default) to open the transfer menu.

[*]Use the arrows on the [b]Left[/b] to select the Source building (where the animals are now).

[*]Use the arrows on the [b]Right[/b] to select the Destination building (where you want them to go).

[*]Click the icons of the animals you want to move. They will highlight [color=green]Green[/color].

[*]Click the large [b]Transfer Arrow[/b] button at the bottom.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41425/41425-1768791070-345742449.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41425/41425-1768791071-985542764.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].

[*]Download this mod.

[*]Unzip the folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.

[*]Run the game.

[/list][size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
By default, the menu key is set to [b]Z[/b]. If you want to change it:

[list=1]
[*]Run the game once to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file.

[*]Open the file located in [font=Courier New]Mods/MassAnimalMover/config.json[/font].

[*]Change [font=Courier New]"OpenMenuKey": "Z"[/font] to your desired key (e.g., "P", "M", "OemTilde").

[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE).
[*]Safe to add or remove from existing saves.
[/list][center][i]Enjoy your organized farm!
